scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: Local continuous transforms - context-sensitive numeric transforms (e.g., quantile transforms per segment).

H56_LOCAL_TRANSFORMS.question: Do context-sensitive numeric transforms (quantile transforms per customer segment) improve fold-0 OOF AUC?
H56_LOCAL_TRANSFORMS.method: For each numeric feature, compute quantile transform conditioned on categorical segment (Customer Type x Class). Cross-fit: fit transforms on folds 1-4, apply to fold-0. Add transformed features to 21raw. LGBM fold-0.
H56_LOCAL_TRANSFORMS.leakage: Transforms fit on FIT only (folds 1-4). Applied to fold-0. Fold-safe.
H56_LOCAL_TRANSFORMS.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
